name: definition-table-subdivision-too-few-boundaries
description: Invalid definition (fiscalclock 0.3.0). Spec rule, paraphrased: A table subdivision's boundaries has at least 2 entries; fewer is INVALID_VALUE at subdivision.boundaries. The definition has no other error, so the complete error list is asserted (code and path of each error, sorted by path, then code).
